description: This PHP class defines the OAuthClientModel which acts as a data model for OAuth client information within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for ID, name, client ID, redirect URI, as well as enabled and confidential status, and utilizes traits for serialization and normalization.

classes.name: OAuthClientModel
classes.description: A model class representing OAuth client data, including serialization configuration and constructor for setting entity data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an OAuthClient entity and configures serialization filters and attribute names.
